subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises at least three new vowel digraphs ('oa' boat, 'ea' eat, short 'oo' book, 'ai' train)

show.line: Boat, coat, goat. Train, rain, snail. Eat, leaf, sea. Two letters in the middle make one long sound!

rounds.prompt: Which picture has the middle sound of boat?
rounds.praise: Yes! Boat, goat. Same middle sound.

rounds.prompt: Which picture has the middle sound of train?
Read this word. It has the middle sound of eat.
Read this word. It has the middle sound of boat.
Book and look have a short middle sound. Which picture has the short sound of book?
rounds.praise: Yes! Book, hook. Short and quick.

rounds.prompt: Middle sound like boat, or like train? Put each picture in its group.

hints: Stretch the middle of the word. Boooat. Traaain.
Say the two words. Do the middles sound the same?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word with the middle sound of boat.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Train! Train sounds like boat in the middle.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Train has the rain sound. Goat has the boat sound.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Boat, goat. Same middle sound!

parent_line: Can hear and read the vowel sounds in boat, train, eat and book.
